name: Indie Folk
description: Open-tuning drone suite with fingerpicked intro, narrative verses, a dominant V lift, and an ensemble climax.

defaults.concept: Indie folk open-tuning drone — organic fingerpicked acoustic patterns, a ringing root drone string, foot-stomp MIDI layers on every downbeat, building to full acoustic ensemble saturation.

slots.label: Acoustic Fingerpick Intro
slots.purpose: FEEL: Organic, woody, rolling. PRODUCTION NOTE: Acoustic patterns layout a driving modal Open-D drone framework. No kick drum transients are present yet.

slots.label: Verse (Narrative Bed)
slots.purpose: FEEL: Storytelling focus, calm momentum. PRODUCTION NOTE: Melodies weave simple harmonic steps between the root and subdominant chords over the ringing root guitar drone string.

slots.label: The Chorus Lift
slots.purpose: FEEL: Uplifting, rootsy, open. TRICK: Introduce the dominant V chord for the first time to create an open cadential lift. A steady acoustic foot-stomp MIDI layer triggers on every downbeat.

slots.label: The Ensemble Climax
slots.purpose: FEEL: Cascading, full acoustic saturation. PRODUCTION NOTE: Arrange dense instrumental counter-melodies on the subdominant chord. The drum clip scales up to a riding, rhythmic pulse with active rolling subdivisions.
